verification.runtime_check: Ran the real stack (Docker) and the real web/map.js + vendored Leaflet in jsdom (800x600 stubbed layout) against the live API, calling setPoint and clicking the real buttons. A real browser could not be launched: Edge headless exits silently under the sandbox, and I did not bypass the sandbox. Not exercised: real rendering, tile load, visual tint, colors, actual map clicks, real fitBounds animation. Stubbed fetch for non-producible errors.

bug.description: False "No match found" on valid rides: when a stop name occurs twice on a record and both occurrences project to the same line position (grey_out/purple_out reuse the same road), all pair gaps tie and the first pair wins; if that pair has dest index below origin it is rejected as wraparound. About 25% of unique rides from random trips (76 of 297) are affected; almost all grey and purple. Wraparound check uses the tied pair instead of any valid forward pair.
bug.reproduction: Docker stack seeded. Origin 15.1481501,120.6010236 is not needed; use the stops: GET /api/plan from (Ocampo's Appliances) to (Addessa) -> ride grey_out "Ocampo's Appliances" to "Addessa" (6 stops). On grey_out, Ocampo's is index 50, Addessa occurs at 41 and 56 with identical line position; matchRide picks (50,41) and returns null. Full-UI repro: from 15.1518763,120.5914184 to 15.1659488,120.5900854 (grey, Aero Metal Force Trading to The Court Yard, 18 stops; valid pair 67->85, picked 30->11) shows "No match found" and everything stays visible.

bug.description: Wrong stretch highlighted when the shortest-line-gap pair differs from the ridden pair (duplicate names with different line positions). Highlight is drawn for the shortest-gap pair, not the stops actually ridden.
bug.reproduction: grey_out ride "Better Living Tile and Bath Center" to "Diamond Home Plaza" (API: 11 stops; valid indexes 31->42). Matcher chose 31->55 (24 stops) because its line gap is shorter than 31 to 42's wrap. 13 such mismatches among 297 unique rides (some are visually identical because positions coincide; this one is not).

bug.description: A timed banner shown while a persistent load-error banner is up overwrites it and later hides it; the load message is not restored. Reachable when route load failed (no records), user taps two points and presses Find route.
bug.reproduction: Call showBanner(load message), set two points, make /api/plan return 500 internal_error, click Find route: banner shows the plan text, and after 5 s the banner is hidden and the load message is gone.

verification.notes: Bugs 1 and 2 follow the owner rule literally (spec 10 and answers C: shortest stretch, wraparound if dest index lower), so the rule itself needs an owner decision (for example, prefer a pair whose index distance equals stops_passed). Seam handling: the seeded circular routes (yellow, purple, grey) have no repeated end stop (first and last names differ), so the seam path in the code is never exercised by the data; a ride past the last stop is treated as wraparound and shows No match found (5 such rides observed, which is correct per answers.md). Also: pytest.ini in the repo is a directory (odd), pytest still ran. Docker containers left running.
verification.self_critique: No real browser: no visual check of tint, highlight weight, fit, panel layout, banner placement over the map, or real tap handling; jsdom layout is faked. Stubbed fetch was used for error statuses. Rides counted "valid" assume stops_passed equals index difference, which holds for the API as observed but is my inference. Random sampling, not exhaustive.
